fields.label: Venue Code
fields.description: Unique short code for this venue (e.g. LH-01, LAB-A3). Used as the document ID.

fields.label: Venue Type
fields.options:
Lecture Hall
Classroom
Laboratory
Seminar Room
Auditorium
Office
Computer Lab
Library
Other

fields.label: Building Name
fields.description: Name of the building this venue is in (e.g. Block A, Science Complex)

fields.label: Floor Number
fields.description: Floor level: 0 = Ground floor, 1 = First floor, -1 = Basement

fields.label: Location Description
fields.description: Human-readable location detail (e.g. Block A, 2nd Floor, East Wing)

fields.label: Capacity
fields.description: Maximum number of people this venue can hold

fields.label: Available Resources
fields.description: Comma-separated list of equipment available (e.g. Projector, Whiteboard, Lab computers, AC)

fields.label: Accessibility Features
fields.description: Features for users with disabilities (e.g. Wheelchair ramp, Hearing loop, Elevator access, Braille signage)

fields.label: GPS Coordinates & Navigation
fields.description: Required for map display and navigation assistance

fields.label: Latitude
fields.description: GPS latitude in decimal degrees (e.g. -6.792354). Get this from Google Maps.

fields.label: Longitude
fields.description: GPS longitude in decimal degrees (e.g. 39.208328). Get this from Google Maps.

fields.label: Map Link
fields.description: Optional direct Google Maps or campus map URL for this venue

fields.label: Navigation Notes
fields.description: Step-by-step instructions to reach this venue (e.g. Enter from main gate, turn left at reception, second door on right)

fields.label: Status History
fields.description: Automatic log of every status transition for this venue (FR-14)

fields.label: Status History
fields.description: Each row is one status transition — written automatically, never manually
